scenario: All scope forms compile cleanly in a single file per LSCP.1.5 — the base values `explicit`, `logical`, `ttl <dur>`, `activation`, plus the `ambient` overlay modifier on a `logical` base (`scope logical ambient`). Each produces its schema lifecycle in the compiled output. Pin: five schemas with distinct scopes all declare without error.
rules_ds:
schema ExplicitFact scope explicit:
    v: Int

schema LogicalFact scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema TtlFact scope ttl 5_min:
    v: Int

schema ActivationFact scope activation:
    v: Int

schema AmbientFact scope logical ambient:
    v: Int key

schema Trigger scope ttl 1_min:
    v: Int

rule r:
    Trigger t where t.v > 0
->
    emit LogicalFact logical v: t.v
